sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Explain the fundamental function of an air pump in a Deep Water Culture (DWC) hydroponic system. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: An air pump continuously supplies essential oxygen to the water reservoir through an airstone, preventing plant roots from suffocating and promoting healthy, rapid crop growth.

questions.question_text: State the primary nutritional difference between concentrates and roughage in the daily diet of farm animals. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Roughage is bulky feed high in dietary fiber, like hay, while concentrates are nutrient-dense feeds packed with proteins and carbohydrates, such as oilcakes and grains.

questions.question_text: Describe why sandpaper must be systematically applied to wooden or bamboo surfaces during the finishing stage of carpentry. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Sandpaper is rigorously rubbed across the surface to eliminate rough splinters and uneven edges, creating a perfectly smooth, safe texture ready for polishing or varnishing.

questions.question_text: Your student team is conducting a water audit and discovers three severely leaking taps in the primary washroom. Outline the immediate practical steps you must take to manage and document this wastage effectively. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: First, immediately place buckets under the leaking taps to collect and repurpose the wasted water. Next, accurately record the leakage rate using a stopwatch and measuring cylinder. Finally, submit a detailed repair report to the school maintenance department.
